steps.rawOutput:
Only Admins can remove team members from your workspace. As an Editor, you don't have access to user management capabilities. You'll need to ask an Admin to remove your colleague from Account Settings > Team. When a member is removed, their access is immediately revoked.

If you need help identifying who the Admins are in your workspace, or if you have other questions about role permissions, feel free to reach out.
